title: mail: JMAP session base URL and account ID hardcoded
description: Why: build_session("anonymous", "http://localhost") in server.rs:62 hardcodes both the JMAP account ID and the base URL used for download/upload endpoints. The http://localhost base URL will produce broken blob download links in any non-localhost deployment.\n\nWhat: Add [jmap] base_url (required, e.g. https://mail.example.com) and account_id (default "anonymous") to MailConfig; wire into build_session() call in server.rs.
